title: examples/ moved into the pnpm workspace and covered by the root test ladder

environment.workingTree: changes uncommitted; no commit, push, tag, publish or deploy performed

before.consequence: examples/tests/examples.test.ts (4 real cases) was not executed by pnpm test, and a bare `vitest run` inside examples/ inherited the root projects glob and failed with 'No projects were found'.

fix.kind: workspace membership plus a package-local Vitest configuration

changes.change: new local config so the package is runnable in isolation
root projects include examples; product coverage denominator remains packages/* and plugins/*
C3 marked closed; counts updated to 63 files / 744 cases, typecheck 10/10, lint 162 files, build 8/8, clean 8/8
badge and test-status table updated to 63 files / 744 cases; clean 8/8
monorepo layout now lists examples/ and the current orchestrator count (64)
empty changeset: dev/test tooling only, no published package version bump

coverage.note: product denominator is packages/*/src and plugins/*/src; examples/ is a demo app and is deliberately excluded from the coverage denominator while its tests still run

regressionProof.preFix: A bare `pnpm --filter behavioros-examples test` failed before examples/vitest.config.ts existed: 'No projects were found. The projects definition: [packages/*, plugins/*]'.
regressionProof.postFix: The same command runs 4/4 cases; root `pnpm test --force` reports 8 tasks and 63 files / 744 cases.
regressionProof.isolation: examples/vitest.config.ts keeps the package runnable without changing the root project list.

limitations: examples/src/index.ts is a demo entrypoint whose main() is not imported by the 4 tests; it is intentionally outside the product coverage denominator.
Docker is not installed in this environment, so the container image was not built or run.
The working tree contains pre-existing uncommitted notification, vitest and control-loop changes; they were preserved and re-verified, not authored by this mission.
Release automation remains human-gated and unverified; no commit, push, tag, publish or deploy was performed.
notDone: git commit, merge, push, tag, publish or deploy
